About Turing 
 Turing is one of the world’s fastest-growing AI companies, accelerating the advancement and deployment of powerful AI systems.
 Turing helps customers in two ways: Working with the world’s leading AI labs to advance frontier model capabilities in thinking, reasoning, coding, agentic behavior, multimodality, multilinguality, STEM, and frontier knowledge; and leveraging that work to build real-world AI systems that solve mission-critical priorities for companies.

 Role Overview 
 We are seeking experienced Clinical & Health Subject Matter Experts (SMEs) to author, evaluate, and calibrate high-fidelity clinical tasks, long-chart scenarios, workplace simulations, and benchmark evaluation rubrics.
 This unified opening covers contributors across multiple clinical, behavioral-health, revenue-cycle, quality, pharmacy, rehabilitation, and healthcare-operations disciplines. Candidates will be placed in either an Expert Contributor or Senior Specialist / Functional Lead track based on clinical depth, years of experience, active licensure or certification, leadership experience, and prior review or calibration expertise.
 Clinical & Health Disciplines Covered
 • Acute-Care Physical, Occupational, and Speech-Language Therapy
• Pathology, Laboratory Cytotechnology, and Genetic Counseling
• Utilization Management, Prior Authorization, and Payer Claims
• Dietetics, Nutrition, Diabetes Education, and Chronic-Disease Education
• Hospital Social Work and Behavioral-Health Therapy
• Clinical Quality Improvement, Patient Safety, Infection Prevention, and EVS Policy
• Medical Coding, CDI, Billing, and Denials
• Hospital Pharmacy and Clinical Pharmacology
• Psychiatry, Addiction Medicine, and Behavioral Health
• Emergency Medicine, EMS Medical Direction, Paramedic, and EMT Handoffs
 Requirements
 • Approximately 3 to 15+ years of demonstrable professional experience in one or more relevant Clinical & Health disciplines.
• Current or recent practice within the last three years in the applicable clinical, hospital, payer, laboratory, behavioral-health, revenue-cycle, or quality setting.
• Active professional licensure, board certification, or recognized credential appropriate to the discipline.
• Strong clinical reasoning, chart-review, documentation, and written communication skills.
• Ability to interpret fragmented medical records, reconcile conflicting information, identify missing or unsafe actions, and produce clinically defensible conclusions.
• High attention to detail, particularly regarding patient safety, clinical terminology, medical necessity, coding accuracy, payer requirements, regulatory standards, and documentation gaps.
• Ability to work within structured review cycles, standardized rubrics, and fast-paced calibration environments.
• Familiarity with US clinical guidelines, payer policies, regulatory requirements, and healthcare workflows is preferred. Relevant reference materials may be supplied in context for non-US contributors.
 Role-Specific Qualifications
 Depending on the assigned discipline, relevant qualifications may include:
 • Active PT, OT, SLP, RN, RD/RDN, LCSW, PharmD, MD, DO, or other applicable professional license.
• Board certification or specialist credentials such as BCPS, BCCCP, CIC, CPHQ, CPPS, CCS, CPC, CDIP, CCDS, CDCES, ABEM, ABPN, ABPM, or equivalent.
• Experience with acute-care rehabilitation, swallow evaluation, nutrition support, diabetes education, utilization management, prior authorization, payer appeals, medical coding, CDI, infection prevention, NHSN reporting, medication reconciliation, addiction medicine, emergency medicine, or EMS medical direction.
• Experience authoring or reviewing complex clinical documentation, longitudinal charts, discharge plans, medical-necessity determinations, coding assignments, safety assessments, or quality audits.
 Responsibilities
 • Clinical Benchmark Authoring & Task Design: Develop high-difficulty clinical tasks, long-chart scenarios, realistic workplace cases, gold-standard answers, and evaluation criteria within the assigned discipline.

• Longitudinal Chart Synthesis: Evaluate fragmented, multi-encounter records and identify clinically meaningful trends, contradictions, omissions, risks, and required actions.

• Clinical Accuracy & Safety Review: Assess whether outputs are clinically accurate, practical, evidence-aligned, patient-safe, and appropriate for the relevant care setting.

• Rubric Application & Scoring: Apply evaluation criteria defined by the Functional SME Lead to assess outputs for clinical reasoning, terminology, documentation quality, regulatory alignment, payer accuracy, and patient-safety implications.

• Specialty Task Evaluation: Depending on the assigned area, review tasks involving mobility and discharge planning, swallow and diet-texture recommendations, medical necessity, prior authorization, claims and denials, nutrition support, diabetes management, psychosocial safety, infection prevention, coding and CDI, medication safety, addiction treatment, emergency decision-making, or EMS handoffs.

• Peer Review & Calibration — Senior Track: Review and calibrate pod members’ work, resolve edge-case ambiguities, identify rubric inconsistencies, and maintain day-to-day quality standards.

• Cross-Functional Review: Evaluate tasks that require coordination across physicians, nurses, therapists, pharmacists, social workers, dietitians, coders, case managers, payers, laboratory professionals, or emergency personnel.

• Iterative Refinement: Incorporate calibration feedback, revise task content and solutions, and participate in multiple critique cycles to align deliverables with project standards.

• Escalation & Quality Ownership — Senior Track: Escalate genuine clinical, regulatory, or rubric ambiguities to the Functional SME Lead and support consistent decision-making across the pod.

 Education & Experience
 • Bachelor’s degree, graduate degree, professional degree, or equivalent practical experience in a relevant healthcare discipline.
• Active professional license, board certification, or recognized industry credential where applicable.
• Experience in clinical practice, healthcare operations, medical review, AI evaluation, data annotation, content review, quality assurance, clinical documentation, or a related analytical role is preferred.
• Prior experience reviewing expert work, creating clinical education content, developing assessment materials, or participating in quality-improvement programs is advantageous.
 Senior Specialist / Functional Lead Expectations
 Senior contributors may be responsible for:
 • Authoring high-difficulty tasks and gold-standard solutions.
• Reviewing and calibrating work produced by Expert Contributors.
• Maintaining quality across a designated Clinical & Health pod.
• Resolving complex clinical, safety, documentation, payer, or regulatory edge cases.
• Supporting rubric development and identifying gaps in evaluation criteria.
• Grading adjacent specialties where clinically appropriate, such as behavioral-health safety, nursing documentation, case management, paramedic handoffs, payer claims, or clinical quality tasks.
 Offer Details
 • Commitment Required: At least 4 hours per day and up to 40 hours per week.
• Overlap Requirement: 4 hours of overlap with PST.
• Engagement Type: Contractor.
• Engagement Length: 12 weeks.
 Evaluation Process
 • Applicants must submit the Job Interest Form and complete the relevant assessment.
• Selected applicants may be invited to complete a discipline-specific review or calibration exercise.
• Final selected candidates will be contacted regarding next steps, contracting, and onboarding requirements.

vagas.titulo: Senior DevOps Engineer (Cloud Infrastructure, CI/CD, LLMOps)
vagas.descricao:
Our client is a global technology company specializing in cloud infrastructure, AI operations, and enterprise technology solutions. Supporting organizations worldwide, the company delivers secure, scalable, and reliable cloud environments, helping businesses optimize infrastructure and accelerate AI adoption.

 We are looking for a Senior DevOps Engineer to architect, optimize, and own complex cloud infrastructure and CI/CD systems, including MLOps pipelines supporting AI/ML workloads. In this role, you will drive technical decisions, design highly available and cost-efficient architectures, and ensure the security, reliability, and performance of infrastructure across multiple services.

 You will lead infrastructure design reviews, mentor engineers, and collaborate with cross-functional stakeholders to translate business requirements into technical solutions. You will also lead incident response and root-cause analysis for critical infrastructure issues, implement monitoring for AI workloads, and strengthen security controls for AI endpoints and agentic systems. Participation in an on-call rotation for after-hours and weekend support is expected.

 Required Skills
 • 6+ years of experience in technology, with significant ownership of cloud infrastructure and DevOps systems.
 • 4+ years of hands-on experience designing, implementing, and optimizing cloud infrastructure and CI/CD pipelines.
 • Advanced expertise in cloud platforms, containerization, orchestration, and Infrastructure as Code (IaC).
 • Strong experience architecting highly available, scalable, secure, and cost-optimized infrastructure.
 • Experience designing and maintaining CI/CD pipelines for distributed applications and AI/ML workloads.
 • Understanding of LLMOps principles, including AI model deployment, monitoring, and operational performance.
 • Knowledge of AI infrastructure observability, including latency, token costs, model drift, and alerting.
 • Experience implementing infrastructure security, compliance controls, and secure deployment practices.
 • Understanding of security risks associated with AI endpoints, including prompt injection and data leakage.
 • Experience leading technical design reviews, mentoring engineers, and collaborating with cross-functional teams.
 • Strong incident management, troubleshooting, and root-cause analysis skills.
 • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
 Bonus Skills
 • Professional-level cloud certification (AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud).
 • Experience operating LLMOps infrastructure at scale, including GPU provisioning and vector database hosting.
 • Experience securing agentic AI systems and AI-powered applications.
 • Experience establishing infrastructure standards and contributing to technical roadmaps.
